verses.t: By the sun and its brightness
verses.pickthall: By the sun and his brightness
verses.yusufAli: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour
verses.rodwell: BY the SUN and his noonday brightness
verses.sale: By the sun, and its rising brightness

verses.t: And [by] the moon when it follows it
verses.pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him
verses.yusufAli: By the Moon as she follows him
verses.rodwell: By the Moon when she followeth him
verses.sale: by the moon, when she followeth him

verses.t: And [by] the day when it displays it
verses.pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him
verses.yusufAli: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory
verses.rodwell: By the Day when it revealeth his glory
verses.sale: by the day, when it sheweth his splendor

verses.t: And [by] the night when it covers it
verses.pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him
verses.yusufAli: By the Night as it conceals it
verses.rodwell: By the Night when it enshroudeth him
verses.sale: by the night, when it covereth him with darkness

verses.t: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
verses.pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it
verses.yusufAli: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure
verses.rodwell: By the Heaven and Him who built it
verses.sale: by the heaven, and Him who built it

verses.t: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
verses.pickthall: And the earth and Him Who spread it
verses.yusufAli: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse
verses.rodwell: By the Earth and Him who spread it forth
verses.sale: by the earth, and Him who spread it forth

verses.t: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
verses.pickthall: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
verses.yusufAli: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it
verses.rodwell: By a Soul and Him who balanced it
verses.sale: by the soul, and Him who completely formed it

verses.t: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness
verses.pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it
verses.yusufAli: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right
verses.rodwell: And breathed into it its wickedness and its piety
verses.sale: and inspired into the same its faculty of distinguishing, and power of choosing, wickedness and piety

verses.t: He has succeeded who purifies it
verses.pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow
verses.yusufAli: Truly he succeeds that purifies it
verses.rodwell: Blessed now is he who hath kept it pure
verses.sale: Now is he who hath purified the same, happy

verses.t: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]
verses.pickthall: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it
verses.yusufAli: And he fails that corrupts it
verses.rodwell: And undone is he who hath corrupted it
verses.sale: but he who hath corrupted the same, is miserable

verses.t: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression
verses.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride
verses.yusufAli: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing
verses.rodwell: Themoud in his impiety rejected the message of the Lord
verses.sale: Thamud accused their prophet Saleh of imposture, through the excess of their wickedness

verses.t: When the most wretched of them was sent forth
verses.pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth
verses.yusufAli: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety)
verses.rodwell: When the greatest wretch among them rushed up
verses.sale: When the wretch among them was sent to slay the camel

verses.t: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink
verses.pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink
verses.yusufAli: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink
verses.rodwell: Said the Apostle of God to them, - "The Camel of God! let her drink
verses.sale: and the apostle of God said unto them, let alone the camel of God; and hinder not her drinking

verses.t: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]
verses.pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings)
verses.yusufAli: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)
verses.rodwell: But they treated him as an impostor and hamstrung her. So their Lord destroyed them for their crime, and visited all alike
verses.sale: But they charged him with imposture; and they slew her. Wherefore their Lord destroyed them, for their crime, and made their punishment equal unto them all

verses.t: And He does not fear the consequence thereof
verses.pickthall: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events)
verses.yusufAli: And for Him is no fear of its consequences
verses.sale: And he feareth not the issue thereof
